name: Ekopak
verdict: Ekopak is a Belgian water-treatment company listed on Euronext Brussels; disclosure notifications show Marc Coucke's Alychlo group holds 57.64% and founder Pieter Loose's Pilovan holds 25.29%. Nothing found.
note: Deinze-based 'sustainable water' company; jersey co-title sponsor of Soudal Quick-Step and AG Insurance-Soudal (own Eko-Wolf-Pak page). Rating note: listed company, disclosed holders documented (claim ekopak-shareholder-structure); no relevant record found.
